answer: A proof-of-burn registry mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to verifiably destroy base currency at an unspendable address before transacting. An attacker attempting to harvest reward nectar incurs a verifiable cost of permanently sacrificed capital per identity, hitting an onyx wall of financial loss regardless of their low-latency copper infrastructure. However, irreversible burning contracts circulating supply and prices out legitimate, low-capital micro-agents.
